{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out refunded orders — only completed orders count
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Step 2: Remove QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99')
filtered_data = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Step 3: Clean revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
filtered_data['revenue_clean'] = filtered_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = filtered_data['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders (to avoid estimating)
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_only)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {len(completed_only) - len(filtered_data)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
